MARKER-FROM-FIRST-RUN Acme Robotics is a company based in Pune. It was founded by Meera Shah in 2015. Acme builds warehouse robots.
Acme has 120 employees.

page_content: Meera Shah studied engineering at IIT Bombay. Before Acme Robotics she worked at Orbit Logistics as a hardware lead.

page_content: Orbit Logistics runs warehouses in Mumbai and Chennai. In 2022 Orbit Logistics signed a supply contract with Acme Robotics.

page_content: The Acme Picker X2 is a warehouse robot that lifts up to 40 kg. Orbit Logistics uses the Picker X2 in its Chennai warehouse.
